newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks seen moving mixed.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks seen moving mixed.

text.p: Share prices on the Dhaka Stock Exchange (DSE) were expected to open mixed on Tuesday amid cautious, pre-budget trading, brokers said.
"Investors are likely to remain cautious till the announcement of the budget," said broker Mahbub Morshed. The national budget for 1997-98 fiscal (July-June) will be announced on Thursday.
The DSE all-share price index closed 8.30 points or 0.71 percent down at 1,159.61 on a turnover of 66.3 million taka on Monday.
